meaning:
thistles or nettles, a thorny or useless plant
Also means: qim.ma.shon (קִמָּשׂוֹן "thorn" H7063)

elsewhere.note: Thorns will come up in its palaces, nettles and thistles in its fortresses; and it will be a habitation of jackals, a court for ostriches.
For, behold, they have gone away from destruction. Egypt will gather them up. Memphis will bury them. Nettles will possess their pleasant things of silver.…
